From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo: Redwood Inference — Acme Health (qualification & scheduling)

Hi Alex —

Thanks for signing up and expressing interest in Redwood. I’d love to set up a quick demo (30 minutes) to walk through how our inference platform can help with your use case. Before we lock something on the calendar, can you answer 3 quick questions so I can tailor the demo?

1) Primary use case you want to solve with Redwood? (e.g., customer support summarization, internal search, clinical note summarization)
2) Typical volume: number of requests/users or tokens per day/week/month?
3) Timeline/priority: pilot this quarter, next quarter, or longer-term?

Below are a few open slots I have this week:
- Wed 6/18 1:00–1:30pm PT
- Thu 6/19 9:00–9:30am PT
- Thu 6/19 3:00–3:30pm PT

If none of those work, send a couple times that do and I’ll get something on the calendar. I can also include Rishi (our product specialist) if you’d like a deeper technical walkthrough.

Thanks — look forward to learning more about Acme Health’s goals.

Best,
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference — Acme Health (qualification & scheduling)

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for reaching out. Quick answers below so you can tailor the session:

1) Primary use case: clinical note summarization and an internal semantic search for clinicians. We want to auto-generate concise encounter summaries and make past notes searchable by symptoms, meds, and procedures.

2) Typical volume: right now a pilot would include ~50k notes / month (avg ~1,000 tokens per note), so ballpark ~50M tokens/month initially. If we expand to the whole org, it could be 5–10x that.

3) Timeline: high priority — pilot in ~6 weeks, production in 3–6 months depending on pilot outcomes.

I can do Wed 6/18 at 1pm PT but need to push by 30 minutes later if possible (1:30pm PT), or Thu 6/19 9am PT also works.

Also, can you have someone who can speak to security & data residency on the call? We’ll likely want to validate SOC2 / data handling during the pilot.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Data Engineering, Acme Health
alex.turner@acmehealth.com | (206) 555-0199
